name: kite
description: Remember what your team decided, who owns it now, and why it changed.

interface.shortDescription: Recall the latest decision, its owner, and the original evidence.
interface.longDescription: Turn meetings into memory for future chats. Explore topics, entities, and original quotes in the memory graph, and trace changing decisions and assignments.
defaultPrompt: Show me how KITE remembers a changed release decision.
Use KITE to draft my next steps from the latest decisions and owners.
